{{Top|leg}}
The '''UP236-TDC''', or '''uranium/pollonium-236 tactical demolition charge''', was a [[Bomb/Legends|demolition charge]] that utilized a small disc of [[Uranium/Legends|uranium]] and a wedge of [[pollonium-236]], surrounded by a number of [[Shaped charge/Legends|shaped charges]]. Essentially a small [[Nuclear weapon/Legends|nuclear bomb]], the UP236-TDC induced nuclear fusion through kinetic force; the TDC's small size and high yield made it a favorite for scorched-earth operations during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]].
